pricing.title: Simple pricing, upgrade when you need it
pricing.subtitle: Every plan includes the full editor. Paid plans add AI credits, bigger exports and no watermark.

free.name: Free
free.blurb: Try every tool, export with a small watermark.

plus.name: Plus
plus.blurb: For regular creators who want clean exports.

pro.name: Pro
pro.blurb: Heavier AI use and larger exports.

team.name: Team
team.blurb: Shared seats for a small team.

bundles.title: Need credits without a subscription?
bundles.subtitle: One-time top-ups on top of whatever plan you're on. They never expire.

waitlist.title: Not open for purchase yet
waitlist.body: Billing is rolling out gradually. Leave your email and we'll let you know the moment it's ready.
waitlist.success: You're on the list — we'll email you when it's ready.
waitlist.error: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

cancel.a: Yes. Cancel from Settings → Billing, no questions asked. You keep access until the end of the period you already paid for.

credits.a: AI tools (background remover, image generator, writer) are metered by credits, because each call costs us a provider fee. Editing, templates and exports are never metered.

rollover.a: No — the monthly grant tops you back up to your plan's allowance rather than stacking. One-time credit bundles never expire, though.

switch.a: Yes, anytime from Settings → Billing. Stripe prorates the difference automatically.

status.success: Thanks! Your plan updates in a moment — refresh Settings if it hasn't yet.
status.canceled: Checkout canceled. No changes were made.

settings.title: Billing
settings.disabledNote: Billing isn't enabled in this environment yet — upgrades go through the waitlist on the pricing page.
